meta.title: Valorant Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert any game's sensitivity to Valorant. Enter your DPI and source sensitivity for an instant match.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_1De: Type your current Valorant sensitivity value. This is the number found in Settings → General → Mouse → Sensitivity: Aim.
steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game you want to convert to. The calculator uses proven mathematical formulas to match your 360° rotation distance across games.
steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_3De: Copy the converted sensitivity and paste it into the target game's settings. Warm up in deathmatch for 10-15 minutes after changing sensitivity.
desc: Convert any game's sensitivity to Valorant. Enter your DPI and source sensitivity for an instant match.
